## Responsibility

`ImportAnalyzer` port on oxc: import extraction with oxc-parser, resolution with oxc-resolver (tsconfig paths, package exports, workspace links).

## Invariants

- Node builtins are external, never files [[cite: packages/plugin-typescript/src/oxc-import-analyzer.ts:77 | "if (specifier.startsWith(\"node:\")) return { type: \"external\", name: specifier };"]].

## Allowed dependencies

`@metator/core`, `oxc-parser` and `oxc-resolver` (ADR-0017).

## Pitfalls

- Bump `OxcImportAnalyzer.id` when `parse` extracts something new; otherwise the import index keeps serving old parses.
- CommonJS `require()` is not analyzed.
